import os,json,concurrent.futures,subprocess,pathlib,hashlib
root=pathlib.Path(__file__).parent
states=json.load(open(root/'wasm-api/states.json'))
for i in range(4):
 (root/f'wasm-shard-{i}.json').write_text(json.dumps({'total':len(states),'shardIndex':i,'shardCount':4,'stateIndices':list(range(i,len(states),4)),'states':states[i::4],'scanStates':[s for s in states if s[0].endswith('-expanded')]}))
def run(i):
 env=os.environ|dict(EHR_RENDER_SHARD_COUNT='4',EHR_RENDER_SHARD_INDEX=str(i),EHR_RENDER_SHARD_INPUT=str(root/f'wasm-shard-{i}.json'),EHR_RENDER_SHARD_REPORT=str(root/f'wasm-shard-{i}-report.json'))
 with (root/f'wasm-shard-{i}.log').open('w') as out:
  p=subprocess.run(['node','lean/Ehr/Render/test-wasm.mjs',str(root/'wasm-api')],stdout=out,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,env=env)
 print(i,p.returncode,flush=True)
 return p.returncode
with concurrent.futures.ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=4) as ex: codes=list(ex.map(run,range(4)))
assert not any(codes),codes
reports=[json.load(open(root/f'wasm-shard-{i}-report.json')) for i in range(4)]
indices=[n for r in reports for n in r['stateIndices']]
assert sorted(indices)==list(range(len(states))) and len(indices)==len(set(indices))
assert len({r['nativeSha256'] for r in reports})==1 and len({r['wasmSha256'] for r in reports})==1
print(json.dumps({'status':'passed','states':len(states),'bundlesPerShard':[r['bundleCount'] for r in reports],'nativeSha256':reports[0]['nativeSha256'],'wasmSha256':reports[0]['wasmSha256']}))

from pathlib import Path
root=Path('/home/saithat/Projects/run-tmp/merge-two-20261107')
name,command=sys.argv[1:3]
if name == "mar-adt":
 command = command.replace("COMMIT_INTERNAL_URL=http://127.0.0.1:18090", "COMMIT_INTERNAL_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8091")
env=os.environ|dict(TMPDIR=str(root.parent), CI='true', LEAN_NUM_THREADS='6', EHR_SCREEN_WORKERS='4', COMMIT_FIXTURE=str(root.parent/'commit-fixture.json'), DATABASE_URL='postgres://vgi:vgi-dev-only@127.0.0.1:55438/vgi_commit', COMMIT_PROTOCOL_TRACE_KEEP='1')
if name in {"desktop", "mar-adt"}:
 command = 'PLAYWRIGHT_JSON_OUTPUT_NAME="' + str(root/(name+"-playwright.json")) + '" ' + command
if name in {'dashboard-shots','audit-templates','audit-personas'} and not (root/'allow-final-audits').exists():
 raise SystemExit('Dashboard contrast validation: final screenshots and audits are gated pending review-only styling checks.')
start=time.time(); path=root/(name+'.log')
with path.open('w') as f:
 p=subprocess.run(['bash','-o','pipefail','-c',command],env=env,stdout=f,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
receipt=dict(name=name,command=command,exit=p.returncode,seconds=round(time.time()-start,3),started=start,log=path.name,sha256=hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest())
(root/(name+'.json')).write_text(json.dumps(receipt,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps(receipt),flush=True)
print('\n'.join(path.read_text(errors='replace').splitlines()[-12:]),flush=True)
sys.exit(p.returncode)
